To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SiO2/ TiO2 nanocomposite has been found to be an efficient electron transport layer for the fabrication of high-efficiency OLEDs based on the PFO/MEHPV system.

the existence of SiO2/ TiO2 nanocomposite can improve the performance of OLEDs, and the improvement of the device performance is related to the increase of hole-electron injection and the reduction of the turn-on voltage.
the presence of Si02/TiO2 nano-composites leads to an increase of the electroluminescent intensity of the MEH-PPVs in the PFO/MEHPVs hybrids and, thus, an enhancement of the performances of OLEDs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the SiO 2/TiO 2 nanocomposites in the hybrids on the optoelectronic properties of PFO/ MEH-PPVBased OLED devices.
the fabrication of hybrid organic-inorganic composites with improved optoelectronic properties for OLED devices.
the fabrication and characterization of PFO/ MEH-PPVs-based OLEDs, in the presence of different amounts of the SiO/TiO2 hybrid nanocomposites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the existence of the nanocomposites led not only to a reduction of the turn-on voltage but also to an enhancement of the electroluminescent efficiency.
the existence of SiO2/ TiO2 nanocomposite is a key factor in the enhancement of the performance of the OLED devices.
the presence of Si02/TiO2 nanoparticles in the PFO/MEHPVV hybrid led to a better performance of the devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SiO2/ TiO2 nanocomposite can be used as an efficient interfacial layer for OLED devices.
the SiO2/ TiO2 nanocomposite can be used as a promising material in OLEDs.
the SiO2/ TiO2 nanocomposite is an effective electron injection material for the fabrication of OLEDs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SiO2/ TiO2 nanocomposite can be used as an effective hole injection layer for OLEDs based on the PFO/MEHPV hybrid.
the SiO2-TiO2 nanomaterials can be used to improve the optoelectronic properties of OLEDs.
the SiO2/ TiO2 nanocomposite can be used in the fabrication of high-performance OLEDs.
